movies.overview: Sisif, a railwayman, saves a young girl named Norma orphaned by a train crash and raises her as his own daughter alongside his son, Elie. As she becomes an adult, Sisif grapples with whether to tell Norma the truth about her parentage.
movies.title: La Roue

movies.overview: A young man falls for a young woman on his trip home; unbeknownst to him, her family has vowed to kill every member of his family.
movies.title: Our Hospitality
movies.tagline: A Comedy with a Heart of Gold

movies.overview: When a store clerk organizes a contest to climb the outside of a tall building, circumstances force him to make the perilous climb himself.
movies.title: Safety Last!
movies.tagline: You're Going to Explode With "Safety Laughs" when You see This Fun Bomb.

movies.overview: The good guys win out in this sweet tale about a young orphan who is abused for much of her life but who eventually finds happiness when she marries an honest man who extricates her from her situation.
movies.title: Cœur fidèle

movies.overview: In 15th century France, a gypsy girl is framed for murder by the infatuated Chief Justice, and only the deformed bellringer of Notre Dame Cathedral can save her.
movies.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame

movies.overview: The rituals of courtship, romantic rivalry, and love play out three times as a man vies with a villain for the girl. In the Stone Age, the rivalry is set off by dinosaurs, a turtle used as a ouija board, and a round of golf with stones. In ancient Rome, the men display their brawn through a chariot race, using dogs instead of horses. In contemporary times, the man finds himself overcome by modernity, including a very fragile car.
movies.title: Three Ages
movies.tagline: A cyclone of laughs and thrills

movies.original_title: L'Affaire de la rue de Lourcine
movies.overview: Back from an alcohol-fueled evening, two former high school friends wake up and find they may have murdered a female coal-dealer.
movies.title: L'Affaire de la rue de Lourcine

movies.overview: Two wagon caravans converge at what is now Kansas City, and combine for the westward push to Oregon. On their quest the pilgrims will experience desert heat, mountain snow, hunger, and Indian attack. To complicate matters further, a love triangle develops, as pretty Molly must chose between Sam, a brute, and Will, the dashing captain of the other caravan. Can Will overcome the skeleton in his closet and win Molly's heart?
movies.title: The Covered Wagon
movies.tagline: The Cowards never started and the Weak died on the way.

movies.overview: During a dinner given by a wealthy baron and his wife, attended by four of her suitors in a 19th century German manor, a shadow-player rescues the marriage by giving all the guests a vision what might happen tonight if the baron stays jealous and the suitors do not reduce their advances towards his beautiful wife. Or was it a vision?
movies.title: Warning Shadows

movies.original_title: A Woman of Paris: A Drama of Fate
movies.overview: When Marie St. Clair believes she has been jilted by her artist fiance Jean, she decides to leave for Paris on her own. After spending a year in the city as a mistress of the wealthy Pierre Revel, she is reunited with Jean by chance. This leaves her with the choice between a glamorous life in Paris, and the true love she left behind.
movies.title: A Woman of Paris: A Drama of Fate
movies.tagline: Humanity is composed not of heroes and villains.

movies.overview: An unhappily married woman devises a scheme to get rid of her husband.
movies.title: The Smiling Madame Beudet

movies.overview: On the surface a straightforward tale of the search for a buried treasure, the film is a textbook example of German expressionism, with the passions of the protagonists conveyed as much through symbolism as action.
movies.title: The Treasure
